about: Attorney Michael F. Bonamarte, IV, is a managing partner at Levin & Perconti law firm in Chicago, Illinois. A highly competent, versatile and passionate trial lawyer, Mr. Bonamarte provides unmatched representation and support to clients throughout the greater Chicago area and all across the state who have legal needs involving any of the following:
· Medical malpractice and nursing home abuse

Over the course of his legal career spanning more than 20 years, Mr. Bonamarte has achieved considerable success advocating on behalf of individuals and families who are suffering as the result of someone else's negligence or wrongdoing. He has secured multimillion-dollar verdicts for his plaintiff clients ever since his first trial with the firm, and since then, he has recovered tens of millions of dollars in settlements and jury awards for those he has served.

Recently, Mike achieved a $40 million birth injury verdict on behalf of a child who suffered HIE. This verdict was recognized at the 2024 Jury Verdict Awards, where Mike received a Trial Excellence Award for the Highest Reported Coles County Verdict. His experience in birth injury litigation continues to grow, with recent successes including a $29 million settlement and a $20 million verdict.

Among his most notable successes, he served as counsel on a failure to diagnose lung cancer case, where he helped secure a verdict of more than $12 million, as well as a case involving wrongful death from escape from an ambulance, where the jury returned a verdict of $7 million. He was also instrumental in helping to secure a settlement of $7.5 million for a boat worker injured during an explosion, which stands as a record award regarding a Jones Act claim in the state. In 2024, Mike recovered $5 million for the family of a man who suffered a heart attack in a swimming pool.

Honored for his outstanding legal abilities and impeccable professionalism, Mr. Bonamarte has earned a Leading Lawyer designation from Leading Lawyers every year since 2017. In addition, the Law Bulletin Publishing Company named him to its list of 40 Attorneys Under Forty to Watch in Illinois for 2010, and he received the Trial Lawyers Excellence Award for having secured the highest verdict in the state in a nursing home malpractice case.

A 2001 graduate of the University of Wisconsin-Madison, Mr. Bonamarte obtained his Juris Doctor from The John Marshall Law School in 2005. He is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois, and he is an active member of the American Bar Association, The Chicago Bar Association, the Illinois Trial Lawyers Association and the American Association for Justice.

Mr. Bonamarte is also council member of the Illinois State Bar Association's Young Lawyers Division, and he is the former treasurer of the American Association for Justice's Nursing Home Litigation Group. He was also president of the Justinian Society, and he serves on the board of directors of the River North Business Association. A leader in his field, he has numerous publications to his credit, and he has conducted lectures and continuing legal education seminars across his region on a variety of topics.
